operation.description: Relations that change the state of a component.

relations.name: OPENS
relations.description: A sends a command that puts B in an open state.

relations.name: PERMITS
relations.description: The state of A allows B to occur.
relations.example: Open Luma gate -- PERMITS --> Water flow

monitoring.description: Relations that observe a component without changing its state.

relations.name: MONITORS
relations.description: A receives information about the state of B.
